display_long_description:
Welcome to **Gym Bros: LooksMaxx**, where gains are virtual, clout is real, and leg day is a myth. Pump iron, bulk up to absurd proportions, then run, climb, grab and pose your way around a chaotic multiplayer VR gym.

💪 **WORK OUT. BULK UP. STAY SWOL.** – Hit gym machines to grow your arms and pecs. The swoler you get, the higher your **Looks** score when it’s time to pose.

📸 **FLEX FOR THE FEED** – Race to a streaming mirror and physically match the requested pose using your body and hands. Nail it for Looks, climb the podium and flex on the lobby.

🧗 **YOUR HANDS DO THE WORK** – Swing, climb and throw yourself around using your arms, then grab objects, gesture at your bros and use your hands to sell the perfect pose.

👊 **SOCIAL CHAOS FOR UP TO 10 PLAYERS** – Race for machines, compete for mirrors and flex with other players over proximity voice chat. Cross-play with Steam means your bros can join from either platform.

🎭 **CUSTOMIZE YOUR BRO** – Spray-tan yourself radioactive orange, throw on shades, masks or a unibrow, and build the fitness influencer you were never supposed to be.

🎶 **BEYOND THE GAINS** – Hit the dance floor, chill on the beach or hang out with your bros between rounds.

Part competition, part social VR hangout, part parody of gym culture and social media obsession.

💪 **Stay Swol** 💪
